description: This file defines a Python class GeminiService that acts as a wrapper for communicating with Google's Gemini API. It manages API configuration, message exchange for generating AI responses, and listing available models. The class encapsulates the functionality required to integrate Gemini's generative AI into a larger application.

classes.name: GeminiService
classes.description: A service class for interacting with Google's Gemini API, including configuration, conversation management, and model listing functionalities.

methods.name: __init__(self)
methods.description: Initializes the GeminiService by reading environment variables for API key and model, then configuring the Gemini SDK and setting the model to use.

methods.name: str generate_reply( self, history: List[Dict[str, str]], user_message: str )
methods.description: Generates a response from the AI based on conversation history and a user message by formatting the history according to Gemini's expected input, sending the message, and returning the generated text.

methods.name: bool is_configured(self)
methods.description: Checks whether the Gemini service has been properly configured with an API key.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] list_models(self)
methods.description: Fetches and returns a list of available Gemini models with their descriptive details and supported features.
